question: Do the final ASCENT and MABPT model paths use scene adjacency or neighboring-aircraft membership?
hypothesis: Because the registered model configuration disables social interaction, changing only adjacency membership will leave every model output exactly unchanged.

conditions.isolated: Every actor receives a unique scene identifier.
conditions.merged: Every actor receives one shared scene identifier.

decision_rule: All maximum absolute differences must equal zero. Any nonzero value falsifies adjacency invariance and requires a social-context ablation.
claim_boundary: Passing this audit establishes that the current model is actor-history based and does not support a social-interaction contribution claim.
